{"description": "Salmon fillet piece, pale orange-pink flesh with golden seared edges and a slightly flaky surface, moderately moist, lying center-bottom of plate, roughly 9 x 5 cm and about 2 cm thick.", "candidates": ["baked salmon", "seared salmon", "smoked salmon"], "grams": 140},

{"description": "Sliced radishes, thin white-and-red rounds, crisp and glossy, upper center, a modest handful.", "candidates": ["sliced radish", "sliced turnip", "sliced daikon"], "grams": 30},

{"description": "Shredded or sliced white and pale yellow pieces, possibly cheese shavings or sliced garlic/parmesan, thin flakes near center, small amount.", "candidates": ["parmesan shavings", "sliced garlic", "pickled onion"], "grams": 10}
